create_parameterized_test: create a parameterized unittest test case using the parameters decorator to run multiple argument sets
create_named_parameterized_test: create a parameterized test with named_parameters decorator to give each test case a descriptive name
create_parameterized_test_class: create a parameterized test class by decorating the class with parameters to share args across methods
create_coop_test_case: create a cooperative test case base class using CoopTestCase to combine with other metaclass-based test bases
test_parameterized_TestCase: test the parameterized TestCase class to verify it generates individual test cases from parameter tuples
